final_wiki.answer-Q-8808-A88:
2020-11-03 was a Tuesday.

Calculation: January 1, 2020 was a Wednesday. November 3, 2020 is day 308 of the year (2020 was a leap year). 307 days after January 1: 307 mod 7 = 6, so 6 days after Wednesday = Tuesday.
